# RubberQ (Fuzhou RongQing Rubber Co., Ltd.)

> Japanese Formulation. Chinese Precision. Trusted Since 1995.  
> Compounded by Japan. Built in China. Tested in-House.

RubberQ is a specialized B2B manufacturer of custom elastomeric components, high-precision O-rings, vibration dampers, and sealing modules for semiconductor equipment, industrial automation motion systems, and high-reliability industrial applications.

## Executive Summary & Core Capabilities

- **Established**: 1995 (30+ years of Sino-Japanese joint venture heritage in rubber compounding).
- **Manufacturing Facilities**: 2 manufacturing plants in Fuzhou, China, covering over 20,000 m².
- **Mixing & Compounding**: Dedicated A-Mixing line (black rubber) and B-Mixing line (colored/high-purity rubber) to prevent cross-contamination.
- **Certifications**: IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015.
- **Quality Control**: Full ERP traceability from raw polymer to shipped batch; 100% automated AI optical inspection; in-house physical lab (rheometer, tensile tester, 70h@150°C compression set).

## Target Industries & Material Focus

1. **Semiconductor Equipment**: Low outgassing (ASTM E595 TML < 0.20%), plasma-resistant FFKM / FKM O-rings for CVD/ALD/etching chambers. Cleanroom processed per SEMI F57.
2. **Industrial Automation & Motion Control**: Joint vibration dampers, high-fatigue life HNBR/EPDM seals, precision friction pads engineered for high-duty cycling.
3. **Industrial Equipment & Fluid Power**: High-pressure hydraulic seals, NBR/FKM gaskets complying with ISO 3601 tolerances.
4. **Automotive Tier 2**: Precision engine & drivetrain seals co-developed under IATF 16949 quality control.

## Key Technical Pages & Articles

- [Semiconductor Equipment Seals](https://rubberq.com/en/industries/semiconductor): Plasma resistant O-rings & SEMI F57 cleanroom processing.
- [High-Fatigue Motion Dampers](https://rubberq.com/en/products/vibration-dampers): Precision joint dampers and dynamic fatigue control.
- [FKM Elastomer Technical Data](https://rubberq.com/en/materials/fkm): High-temperature & chemical resistance spectrum.
- [Article: Low Outgassing Vacuum Seals](https://rubberq.com/resources/articles/low-outgassing-vacuum-seals-semiconductor): ASTM E595 outgassing data and chamber seal failure prevention.
